notes: Paraphrase queries over six topics, four memories each. Each query names the single memory it should surface; recall@k counts it anywhere in the top k, MRR rewards rank. Neutral content on purpose: this file ships in a public repository.

memories.text: The user prefers writing backend services in Go because of its simple concurrency model and fast compile times.
For Go projects the user insists on table-driven tests and running the race detector in CI before every merge.
The user reaches for Python only for one-off data wrangling scripts and notebooks, never for long-running services.
The user has been reading about Rust ownership rules and wants to try it for a small command-line tool.
The user's favourite dish to cook at home is tonkotsu ramen, simmering the pork broth for twelve hours.
On weekends the user bakes sourdough bread and keeps a rye starter named after a jazz musician.
The user drinks pour-over coffee every morning, ground fresh, and dislikes espresso-based drinks.
The user cannot handle very spicy food and always asks for mild when ordering Thai or Sichuan dishes.
The user trail-runs on Saturday mornings and is training for a 25 kilometre mountain race in spring.
Twice a week the user goes indoor bouldering and recently sent their first V5 problem.
The user tore a meniscus in the left knee two years ago and avoids deep squats since then.
The user swims a kilometre in the ocean pool before work when the water is warmer than eighteen degrees.
Last autumn the user spent three weeks in Japan, mostly in Kyoto temples and small mountain onsen towns.
The user prefers camping in national parks over hotels and owns a lightweight two-person tent.
The user gets anxious on long flights and always books an aisle seat near the front.
The user is planning a cycling holiday through Tuscany next May with two friends from university.
The user plays jazz piano badly but happily and is working through Bill Evans transcriptions.
The user collects vinyl records, mostly 1970s soul and funk, and refuses to stream music at home.
The user saw Radiohead live in 2012 and still calls it the best concert they have attended.
The user bought a second-hand acoustic guitar for their niece's twelfth birthday.
The user reads science fiction on the train and recently finished the whole Culture series by Iain M. Banks.
The user hosts a monthly book club that alternates between novels and popular science books.
The user switched to an e-reader for travel but still buys paper copies of favourite books.
The user writes short poems in a paper notebook and has never shown them to anyone.
